task: Cover the recipe browser (`/`): four recipe cards (Lentil soup, Chickpea curry, Herb omelette, Mushroom lasagne), each with a servings stepper and an Add to plan toggle. The stepper never goes below 1 serving. The plan line (`Plan: 2 recipes · 6 servings`) counts the planned recipes and totals their servings, and follows every change. The tag chips filter the cards to one tag at a time, show `No recipes match` when no card has the tag, and a second click on the active chip clears the filter. Plan membership and servings are stored on the server and survive a reload.
